title: Storage: stack the boxes, then the cup

provenance.source: hand-designed hard scenario: the box stack the plan builds (0.30 m) stands on the cup's later carry path, and the coaster is far enough (0.75 m) that the tool cannot get above the stack there; place the cup first (or detour)

instruction.en: First stack the three storage boxes (largest at the bottom), then put the cup on the coaster.
